# Third-party library material

The vendored standard footprints in `../footprints/` and standard 3D models in `../3d/` are from the KiCad 10.0.7 bundled community libraries, installed 29 October 2026. Copyright: KiCad Library Team and individual contributors.

- https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints
- https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-packages3D
- https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/

These library files are redistributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad design exception; see the accompanying license documents. Standard footprint geometry was retained; 3D paths in board instances were made project-relative. The custom `HouseRules:LMD07057AUE-101B` footprint and envelope VRML model were created for this project from the Wenrun datasheet and are not KiCad community library parts. The LED model shows nominal dimensions, 3 mm standoff and trimmed pins, not a manufacturer-supplied optical model.
